models: Gibson Les Paul (Joe Perry has a Bone Yard signature)
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Joe Perry is famously a Gibson Les Paul player (Billie Perry / Boneyard signatures), Brad Whitford also plays Les Pauls.
guitar.notes: Original was reasonable; refined to emphasize Les Paul as primary for both, dropped Strat mention as less central.

tone.target: bright Marshall hard rock crunch with vocal mid bite
tone.profile: bright Marshall hard rock crunch with vocal mid bite
tone.summary: A tight, crunchy signal chain using a Blues OD boost into the UK 45 amp model, paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet to achieve bright, mid-focused hard rock crunch.
corrections: Keep it more hard-rock than generic crunch
